bounded by rectus capitis posterior major (SRC_Z_RECTUS_POSTERIOR_MAJOR_CAPITIS_MUSCLE_R/_L), obliquus capitis superior (SRC_Z_OBLIQUUS_SUPERIOR_CAPITIS_MUSCLE_R/_L), obliquus capitis inferior (SRC_Z_OBLIQUUS_INFERIOR_CAPITIS_MUSCLE_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Opening between rectus capitis posterior major (superomedial), obliquus capitis superior (superolateral) and obliquus capitis inferior (inferior), in the plane of the three z-anatomy muscles (vertebral artery and suboccipital nerve lie in its floor); both sides.

items.structure: Mastoid process of the temporal bone
items.note: landmark on temporal bone
items.custom_note: Postero-inferior projection of the temporal bone behind the external acoustic meatus, both sides.

items.note: bounded by SCM (SRC_Z_STERNOCLEIDOMASTOID_MUSCLE_R/_L), trapezius descending part (SRC_Z_DESCENDING_PART_OF_TRAPEZIUS_MUSCLE_R/_L), middle third of clavicle (SRC_Z_CLAVICLE_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Region between the posterior border of sternocleidomastoid, the anterior border of trapezius and the middle third of the clavicle (apex where SCM and trapezius meet near the occiput), drawn as a sheet spanning those borders; both sides.

items.note: landmarks of every vertebra; T6 shown as typical (any SRC_Z_VERTEBRA_*)
landmark on vertebra (T6 as typical)
items.custom_note: Both pedicles of T6 (typical thoracic vertebra), joining the body to the arch beside the vertebral foramen.

items.note: landmark on vertebra (T6 as typical)
items.custom_note: Both laminae of T6, the flat plates of the arch between transverse and spinous processes roofing the vertebral foramen.

items.note: foramen of vertebra (T6 as typical)
items.custom_note: Thin disc filling the vertebral foramen of T6 (bounded by body, pedicles and laminae); size measured from the vertebra.

items.note: canal formed by stacked vertebral foramina of SRC_Z_ATLAS_C1..SRC_Z_VERTEBRA_L5 + SRC_Z_SACRUM
items.custom_note: Lining of the canal formed by the stacked vertebral foramina, C1 to the sacral canal (half-widths measured from the z-anatomy vertebrae); open posteriorly so its contents show.

items.note: landmark on vertebra (T6 as typical)
items.custom_note: Spinous process of T6 (long, sloping inferiorly as is typical of mid-thoracic vertebrae).

items.note: landmark on vertebra (T6 as typical)
items.custom_note: Both transverse processes of T6.

items.note: opening between adjacent vertebrae' pedicles (L3/L4 shown; any adjacent pair)
items.custom_note: Opening between the inferior notch of L3 and superior notch of L4 (pedicles above/below, disc/body in front, facet joint behind), both sides; located as the empty space lateral to the canal between L3 and L4.

items.note: C1-C7
landmark on transverse processes of C1-C7 (e.g. SRC_Z_VERTEBRA_C4)
items.custom_note: Plugs filling the transverse foramina of C1-C7 on both sides, centred on the z-anatomy vertebral artery where bone surrounds it (C1-C6); C7 (no artery) placed below C6.

items.structure: Costal articular facets of a thoracic vertebra
items.note: landmark on thoracic vertebrae (T6 as typical)
items.custom_note: Surfaces of T6 that articulate with the ribs: superior and inferior costal demifacets on the body (heads of ribs 6 and 7) and the transverse costal facets (tubercles of rib 6), found as the T6 surface touching the z-anatomy ribs.

items.note: L1-L5
joint not modeled; occipital condyle is a landmark on occipital bone
items.custom_note: Paired synovial joints between the occipital condyles and the superior articular facets of the atlas, drawn as a capsule-like volume spanning the facing surfaces, plus the condyles themselves as patches on the occipital bone.

items.note: joint not modeled; dens is a landmark on axis
items.custom_note: Lateral atlanto-axial joints (facing facets of atlas and axis) and the median joint (dens against the anterior arch), as capsule-like volumes, plus the dens as a patch on the axis.

items.structure: Spinal cord: Cervical, Thoracic, Lumbar, Sacral, Coccygeal regions
items.note: no spinal cord mesh; bodyparts FJ1737 (central canal of spinal cord) traces its course inside the vertebral canal
items.custom_note: Built inside the real z-anatomy spinal dura along the vertebral canal, foramen magnum to the conus tip at L1/L2; cervical and lumbar enlargements from typical cord diameters (one continuous mesh for all regions). The real dura encloses it: hide the dura (right-click) to click it.

items.note: tapered end of absent spinal cord (~L1-L2, SRC_Z_VERTEBRA_L1); cauda equina SRC_Z_CAUDA_EQUINA continues from it
items.custom_note: Tapered lower end of the built spinal cord (T12/L1 to its tip at L1/L2), where the real cauda equina continues.

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal roots and nerves
items.note: spinal ganglion separate: SRC_Z_SPINAL_GANGLION_R/_L

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal roots and nerves
Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal roots and nerves
items.note: roots (SRC_Z_ANTERIOR/POSTERIOR_ROOT_OF_SPINAL_NERVE_R/_L) and SRC_Z_SPINAL_GANGLION_R/_L exist; mixed spinal nerve trunk not modeled
items.custom_note: Short mixed spinal nerve trunk just beyond each real spinal ganglion (where the anterior and posterior roots have joined), in the intervertebral foramen, for the thoracic levels on both sides; it divides at once into the rami.

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal roots and nerves
items.note: not modeled (brachial plexus roots SRC_Z_ROOTS_OF_BRACHIAL_PLEXUS_R/_L are C5-T1 anterior rami)
items.custom_note: Anterior ramus of each built thoracic spinal nerve, running laterally along the lower border of the rib above (the start of the intercostal nerve); both sides. In the neck the brachial plexus roots (real parts) are the C5-T1 anterior rami.

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal roots and nerves
items.note: not modeled
items.custom_note: Posterior ramus of each built thoracic spinal nerve, turning backwards lateral to the articular processes into the deep back muscles; both sides.

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal meninges and spaces
items.note: source mesh is a partial covering of the spinal dura
items.custom_note: The real z-anatomy spinal dura stops at L1/L2; this continues the dural sac around the cauda equina to S2. Appended to the real dura for "Dura mater".

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal meninges and spaces
items.note: would lie just inside SRC_Z_SPINAL_DURA
items.custom_note: Thin membrane just inside the dura, foramen magnum to S2; posterior cut-away (narrower than outer layers so all show).

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal meninges and spaces
items.note: would invest the (absent) spinal cord surface
items.custom_note: Thin layer on the surface of the built spinal cord; posterior cut-away so the cord shows through.

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal meninges and spaces
items.note: between vertebral canal walls (vertebrae) and SRC_Z_SPINAL_DURA
items.custom_note: Fat-filled space between the bony/ligamentous wall of the vertebral canal and the dura, foramen magnum to the sacral canal; posterior cut-away.

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal meninges and spaces
items.note: potential space deep to SRC_Z_SPINAL_DURA
items.custom_note: Potential space between dura and arachnoid, drawn as a very thin layer just inside the dura; posterior cut-away.

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal meninges and spaces
items.note: within SRC_Z_SPINAL_DURA around cord/cauda equina
items.custom_note: CSF space between pia and arachnoid around the built cord, foramen magnum to the conus; posterior cut-away. Below the conus it continues as the lumbar cistern (separate mesh).

items.section: Spinal Cord Gross organization > Spinal meninges and spaces
items.note: subarachnoid space below conus within SRC_Z_SPINAL_DURA, containing SRC_Z_CAUDA_EQUINA (L1/L2-S2)
items.custom_note: Subarachnoid space below the conus (L1/L2 to S2) inside the dural sac, around the real cauda equina; posterior cut-away.
